readerAnswers.route: The new door may save a few steps; it does not make Gemini a different kind of tool.
readerAnswers.eligibility: You also need a personal Google Account, or a work or school account with Gemini enabled by its administrator.
readerAnswers.information: You can choose to upload an image or connect Google apps such as Gmail and Drive.

explainBack: Browser Gemini and the Windows app are two routes into the same product. The app can save a step with Alt + Space, while account rules and what the reader chooses to share still control its scope.
unseenTransfer: For a managed account, a reader first checks whether the administrator has enabled Gemini; a new desktop shell does not override that policy.
repairsMade: Removed any claim of automatic screen or file access.
Bound eligibility to the personal-account or administrator-enabled condition.
Kept the example to a draft with an explicit check before sending.
limitations: Producer assessment is not independent admission.
Native Windows runtime and account-specific availability were not tested.

terms.connected app: connect Google apps such as Gmail and Drive
